reviews.text:
They’re always so nice when one comes in. They do feel my pets fur before they go to back to let me know if they feel matts. My dogs always come back happy, never scared. They are transparent with how long it will take with grooming your baby and they don’t mind if you call them for an update. I appreciate what they
do and pricing is reasonable.
Excellent service

I'm thrilled with how my Camila looked after her grooming! I highly recommend it. She smelled amazing and left very happy. I recommend making an appointment because it's always busy due to the quality of service. The staff is very friendly. I've been taking my dog ​​there for a long time and I know they take excellent care of the dogs.
Excellent service for my puppy, I will definitely return to Guau Dog Grooming.

The first time I took my dog she came home with irritated areas, and something may have gotten in her ears because they were red, she kept itching, also they had more dogs than workers. some dogs get left unattended, where they have the chance to hang themselves if they jump off the table. Never coming back

I came to this place by recommendation of a friend, but the quality of service was extremely poor. First of all, they did not have space for my dog because they overbook dogs without respecting already scheduled appointments.
What worried me the most was the lack of safety they provide for the dogs. They neglect them and leave them alone on a high platform without caring if the dogs could fall or choke with their own collar.
In addition, the experience with my dog was horrible. They completely shaved my dog without my consent, claiming that my dog had mats in their fur, but this was just an excuse because shaving is easier than doing a proper trim, and they also charge a higher price than a regular cut.
Also, when they bathed my dog, they did not protect her ears and water got inside, which caused an infection. I had to take her to the veterinarian, who told me she had excess water and soap in her ears.
Please, if you love your pets, do not take them to this place. The service is terrible.

This is the second time I take my baby here and they did not disappoint once again. He comes out happy instead of scared like the time I took him to PetSmart. His appointment was at 9am and he was ready by 10:40am!!!❤️ They’re very nice
my dog looks great and smells so good ! thank you guau grooming
I love this grooming service; they always make my dogs look beautiful! They're such great people, thank you for everything you do. I know it's not an easy job 😊 …

I had an appointment scheduled for 10:30am. I brought him in @10:15am and it was 1:30pm and he was still not ready. They had only showered him.
She explained Saturdays are most busy. I understand that. So then, have more workers. Why only have the owner and a gentleman knowing it’s so busy. What’s the point of an appointment if 4 hours later, they’re not ready? On top of that, didn’t call me to let me know.
I would not recommend. So many other dog groomers in the neighborhood/area worth better.
My dog loves this place, they always do an amazing job grooming my dog, great friendly staff I recommend this place if you want your pet to look fabulous for any special occasion!

THIS HAS GOT TO BE THE BEST GROOMING EXPERIENCE EVER! FAIRLY PRICED FOR ALL THEY DO! MY PUP COMES OUT LOOKING DAPPER EVERY-TIME! Always give him a cute bandana and they groom in front where you can see, which I love. I do ask for no cologne or perfume but other than that it’s all perfect! ☺️☺️
i high recommend this grooming for showers and maintenances the groom ( because i have a personal groom for only body shape cuts i love they with long hair )
Trimmed my dogs nails quickly and did not hurt my pup. Fairly priced. Cash only.
Very friendly and great service 👍 …

My fur baby has been coming to them since she was a puppy. She is now 4.  I've read some of the bad reviews, and honestly, I don't think ppl who write a bad review value the quality service they offer. They are very personable. They love animals. They treat animals with kindness and respect. It's always a lovely experience. My dog walks right in every time; doesn't fight. She always comes out looking and smelling great! Highly recommend this place.
I have been here twice. They did an excellent job both times with our dog! The staff is friendly and welcoming. We will be returning to them for future grooming needs! 😊 …

My dog ​​came home happy after her haircut.
That gave me the confidence to take her back again. The staff was very friendly.
It’s a good shop ! Definitely really cute only issues that it’s a bit pricey for a dog haircut. The most I’ve spend on my dogs getting groomed
Excellent service!!! They made my dog ​​look super cute and he left happy 😍🐕 …
Really recommend this place .good pricing, fast , and good customer service. Dogs grooming was Great ! looking Fresh,fluffy and smelling good 👍 …
I definitely won't be taking my dog ​​back. I only asked for a trim, and they cut his hair way too short. Definitely not going back.
